# Habr

> Habr is a Russian-language technology community platform for sharing knowledge, articles, and discussions on software development, IT trends, and engineering topics.

Habr (Хабр) is one of the largest IT communities in the Russian-speaking world, featuring user-generated content, technical articles, and collaborative discussions. The platform emphasizes quality content moderation and community-driven knowledge sharing.

## Key Topics

- User Registration
- Account Creation
- Authentication
- Habr Account
- Habr Platform
- Signup Form
- User Agreement
- Privacy Policy
- Community
- Technical Content
